observation: Documentation describes practice workspace, custom notebook/appbook, packaged alternatives and research.
Checkpoint graph validates proposals, dispatches or drafts effects, interrupts, applies approved effects and persists.
Agent facade starts, snapshots, runs and resumes with thread-level locking.
Risk assessment, safe mode, draft, decision and executed outcome are separate.
System One screens, classifies, reranks evidence and selects procedures/tools.
Workspace client starts/probes gateway, exposes tier/call and safe-mode operations.
Guarded MCP mail, calendar and notes tools translate failures.
Heuristic detection, untrusted wrapping, recipient and sender risk.
Workspace gateway implementation is separate; live-provider semantics not fully reviewed.
Inbox retrieval, triage, model-facing representation, draft and proposal are separate.
Task creation accepts source linkage.
Calendar overview and planning functions.
Focus sessions start, finish, stop and capture distractions.
Scheduler registers handlers, rearms work, arms/cancels and handles jobs.
Routine execution and trigger evaluation.
Runtime warm, stop, rebind and clock/status operations.
MemoryProvider and LocalMemoryProvider expose write, recall, standing, update, delete and sweep.
Session capture and staged promotion queue.
Registry, manifests, rank and disclosure.
Storage centralizes persistence and configured backend selection.
Model adapter separates scripted and live response paths.
Governed domain definitions.
ToolContext and typed arguments define proposal contract.
Packaged adapter module present; equivalence to custom harness unverified.
MetaHarness runner present; external execution not verified.
Live-only reviewed revision: workspace export writes governed values and delimited external text to read-only files; hashes tree excluding .git; mode bits are not isolation proof.
Paper workflow has outline and publication reviews, gather, read, organize, fan-out writing and assembly.
Research canonicalizes URLs, gathers, stores and retrieves sources.
Writing subsystem exists; citation accuracy not executed.
Startup script selects interpreter, checks dependencies, then starts backend.main:app via uvicorn; configured default host/port: 127.0.0.1/8020
